result.reason: The redline appropriately extends access to affiliates and contractors and makes the matching third-party-access carve-out, without altering unrelated obligations. However, it does not authorize transfer to a successor, including in an M&A transaction, so it fails even the fallback. It also makes the licence revocable upon any expiration or termination of the Agreement rather than limiting subscription termination to uncured material breach, and it does not provide that any paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable. The phrase “except as expressly permitted under this Agreement” does not itself create successor-transfer rights. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
